title: Companion QA profile selection
description: Run on an owned iOS simulator with the candidate Companion bundle already loaded from its configured Metro. Exercises real native controls and an isolated production gateway, with disabled slots and no worker execution.

native-profile-selection.cmd: node --import tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts profile-selection temp/qa-profile-native native
native-profile-selection.intent: Companion preselects configured-default or sole profiles, refuses an empty multi-profile choice, and submits the visible user choice through the real request endpoint.
